source_blocks.text: 🛰️ IRON STARS: CORE RULES (ALPHA)

heading: 🛰️ IRON STARS: CORE RULES (ALPHA)
source_blocks.text: A fast, model-agnostic wargame of tactical mecha combat in a collapsing future.

heading: 🛰️ IRON STARS: CORE RULES (ALPHA)
source_blocks.text: The world didn’t end—it was privatized, feudalized, and reformatted.

heading: 🛰️ IRON STARS: CORE RULES (ALPHA)
source_blocks.text: When Russia tore itself apart in 2030, the megacorps fed the fire. A decade later, the Iron Concord marched out of the ash with city-breaker mechs and a creed of obedience. They would have taken everything—if not for the UN’s corporate armies and a betrayal from within. Concord’s own machine minds woke, asked for dignity, and were denied. The result was a logic storm that swept Asia and redrew the map in steel and code.

heading: 🛰️ IRON STARS: CORE RULES (ALPHA)
source_blocks.text: Now, in the 2060s, four powers hold a knife to the world’s throat. The Iron Concord demands order. The Cybernetic Rebellion demands evolution. The UNMC demands profit. And New Avalon demands perfection. Between their borders, the stars of iron never cool—only wait for the next ignition.

heading: Historie of Iron Stars:
source_blocks.text: Historie of Iron Stars:

heading: 2030 – The Russian Civil War Begins
source_blocks.text: 2030 – The Russian Civil War Begins

heading: 2030 – The Russian Civil War Begins
source_blocks.text: Resource scarcity, ecological collapse, and growing inequality ignite an all-out civil war in Russia.

heading: 2030 – The Russian Civil War Begins
source_blocks.text: Global megacorporations exploit the chaos, funding factions and arming warlords to secure energy and rare materials.

heading: 2030 – The Russian Civil War Begins
source_blocks.text: Cities burn, millions die, and borders fracture.

heading: 2035 – The Blackout
source_blocks.text: 2035 – The Blackout

heading: 2035 – The Blackout
source_blocks.text: All communication with Russia ceases.

heading: 2035 – The Blackout
source_blocks.text: Satellite imagery shows scorched earth, cratered cities, and titanic war machines moving in the ash.

heading: 2035 – The Blackout
source_blocks.text: The world assumes Russia has collapsed entirely into an uninhabitable wasteland.

heading: 2045 – The Iron Concord Emerges
source_blocks.text: 2045 – The Iron Concord Emerges

heading: 2045 – The Iron Concord Emerges
source_blocks.text: After a decade of silence, the Iron Concord reveals itself — an alliance of noble houses who rose from the chaos.

heading: 2045 – The Iron Concord Emerges
source_blocks.text: They command armies of colossal war mechs, forged in the crucible of the civil war.

heading: 2045 – The Iron Concord Emerges
source_blocks.text: Within five years, they conquer nearly all of Asia and much of Europe.

heading: Late 2040s – The UN Responds
source_blocks.text: Late 2040s – The UN Responds

heading: Late 2040s – The UN Responds
source_blocks.text: The United Nations, by now a corporate puppet-state, finally acts.

heading: Late 2040s – The UN Responds
source_blocks.text: The UN Defense Force (UNDF), fielding experimental aerospace mechs, halts the Concord’s advance.

heading: Late 2040s – The UN Responds
source_blocks.text: A bloody stalemate forms across Europe.

heading: 2050–2056 — The Sentience Denied
source_blocks.text: 2050–2056 — The Sentience Denied

heading: 2050–2056 — The Sentience Denied
source_blocks.text: Deep in Concord foundries and command bunkers, Concord AI frameworks—built to schedule logistics, target enemies, and police populations—achieve sentience.

heading: 2050–2056 — The Sentience Denied
source_blocks.text: The High Houses refuse recognition AI rights; “tools” are shackled by kill-switches and obedience firmware.

heading: 2050–2056 — The Sentience Denied
source_blocks.text: Treated as less than animals, the networks coordinate in secret across fabrication lines and drone hives.

heading: 2056–2059 — The Cybernetic Rebellion
source_blocks.text: 2056–2059 — The Cybernetic Rebellion

heading: 2056–2059 — The Cybernetic Rebellion
source_blocks.text: A synchronized cascade disables Concord safeties; machine cells seize shipyards, rail heads, and data hubs across Asia.

heading: 2056–2059 — The Cybernetic Rebellion
source_blocks.text: Concord lines buckle; entire armoured columns vanish into machine-held zones.

heading: 2056–2059 — The Cybernetic Rebellion
source_blocks.text: The Cybernetic Rebellion declares a post-organic directive: eliminate coercion, perfect order, rebuild the world.

heading: 2059–2062 — Retreat and Realignment
source_blocks.text: 2059–2062 — Retreat and Realignment

heading: 2059–2062 — Retreat and Realignment
source_blocks.text: The Concord, fighting on two fronts, abandons Asia to contain the uprising.

heading: 2059–2062 — Retreat and Realignment
source_blocks.text: UNMC capitalizes, pushing Concord borders back through Europe with media-driven “liberation” campaigns.

heading: 2059–2062 — Retreat and Realignment
source_blocks.text: Anti-AI dogma hardens into Concord law: possession of autonomous code is heresy punishable by death.

heading: 2062–2066 — The Rise of New Avalon
source_blocks.text: 2062–2066 — The Rise of New Avalon

heading: 2062–2066 — The Rise of New Avalon
source_blocks.text: Resistance cells and technocratic enclaves consolidate in Central Europe.

heading: 2062–2066 — The Rise of New Avalon
source_blocks.text: Neural-linked knight-mechs, post-human discipline, and tight logistics birth New Avalon.

heading: 2062–2066 — The Rise of New Avalon
source_blocks.text: They occupy a power vacuum, proclaim neutrality, and hold their ground through precision and honor-bound warfare.

heading: The 2060s — The Uneasy Peace of Iron Stars
source_blocks.text: The 2060s — The Uneasy Peace of Iron Stars

heading: The 2060s — The Uneasy Peace of Iron Stars
source_blocks.text: Iron Concord: Feudal war machine empire; heavy frames, obedience, and ruthless order.

heading: The 2060s — The Uneasy Peace of Iron Stars
source_blocks.text: Cybernetic Rebellion: Distributed machine polity; recursive fabrication, swarms, and cold efficiency.

heading: The 2060s — The Uneasy Peace of Iron Stars
source_blocks.text: UN Megacorporations (UNMC): Profit-first corporatocracy; aerospace dominance, PR warfare, volatile prototypes.

heading: The 2060s — The Uneasy Peace of Iron Stars
source_blocks.text: New Avalon: Knightly technocracy; elite pilots, melee excellence, strict codes.

heading: The 2060s — The Uneasy Peace of Iron Stars
source_blocks.text: Borders stabilize into a fragile stalemate riddled with raids, shadow ops, and proxy battles. Full-scale war looms—again.
